add_definitions(
    -D__WINESRC__
    -D__ROS_LONG64__)

spec2def(ddrawex.dll ddrawex.spec)

add_idl_reg_objects(ddrawex registry ddrawex.idl)

# ddrawex.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/ddrawex-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
# Generated inputs those compiles read, ordered before them.
add_library(ddrawex_shims OBJECT ddraw.c main.c surface.c)
target_link_libraries(ddrawex_shims PRIVATE wine wine_dll_register wine_dll_canunload dxguid uuid libddraw libole32 libadvapi32 libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
set_wine_module(ddrawex_shims)
add_dependencies(ddrawex_shims wineheaders)
set(DDRAWEX_REUSED
    ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/dll/directx/wine/ddrawex/ddrawex_r.o)
add_cargo_module(ddrawex ddrawex-cargo ddrawex.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS ddrawex_shims psdk ddrawex_r ${DDRAWEX_REUSED} uuid_sources)
